title: Perceptron
signature: def perceptron(X: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray, n_epochs: int, lr: float = 1.0) -> tuple
hints: This is an online algorithm. Visit the samples one at a time, in order, and update right away.
A sample counts as a mistake when y_i * (w . x_i + b) <= 0. Zero is a mistake too.
On a mistake: w += lr * y_i * x_i and b += lr * y_i.
